name: Uso to Tegami to Meitantei
source:
On April 1st, I found a letter in a shoebox. Nothing was written on the letter. Is it just a prank or is it a mystery?

There are three endings. Can you reach the truth?

(summary translated from http://dreamlibrary.cside.com/game/april09.html)
translation:
4月1日，我在鞋柜里发现了一封信。信上什么也没有写。这只是一场恶作剧，还是一个谜团？

游戏共有3种结局。你能抵达真相吗？

（简介翻译自http://dreamlibrary.cside.com/game/april09.html）
